args.sql: SELECT r.casenum, fm.casetag FROM returns r JOIN financial_management fm ON r.casenum = fm.casetag LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
  AVG(
    CAST(r.return_details->'shipping'->>'fee' AS numeric) +
    CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'restocking_fee' AS numeric) +
    CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'relabeling_cost' AS numeric) +
    CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'disposal'->>'disposal_cost' AS numeric) +
    CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'repair_costs'->>'repair_estimate' AS numeric) +
    0.5 * CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'sustainability'->>'carbon_footprint' AS numeric) -
    CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'valuation'->>'recovery_value' AS numeric)
  ) as avg_sal
FROM returns r
JOIN financial_management fm ON r.casenum = fm.casetag;

SELECT 
  r.casenum,
  CAST(r.return_details->'shipping'->>'fee' AS numeric) as shipping_fee,
  CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'restocking_fee' AS numeric) as restocking_fee,
  CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'relabeling_cost' AS numeric) as relabeling_cost,
  CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'disposal'->>'disposal_cost' AS numeric) as disposal_cost,
  CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'repair_costs'->>'repair_estimate' AS numeric) as repair_estimate,
  CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'sustainability'->>'carbon_footprint' AS numeric) as carbon_footprint,
  CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'valuation'->>'recovery_value' AS numeric) as recovery_value,
  ROUND(
    (CAST(r.return_details->'shipping'->>'fee' AS numeric) +
    CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'restocking_fee' AS numeric) +
    CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'relabeling_cost' AS numeric) +
    CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'disposal'->>'disposal_cost' AS numeric) +
    CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'repair_costs'->>'repair_estimate' AS numeric) +
    0.5 * CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'sustainability'->>'carbon_footprint' AS numeric) -
    CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'valuation'->>'recovery_value' AS numeric)), 2
  ) as sal
FROM returns r
JOIN financial_management fm ON r.casenum = fm.casetag
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
  ROUND(
    AVG(
      CAST(r.return_details->'shipping'->>'fee' AS numeric) +
      CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'restocking_fee' AS numeric) +
      CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'relabeling_cost' AS numeric) +
      CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'disposal'->>'disposal_cost' AS numeric) +
      CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'repair_costs'->>'repair_estimate' AS numeric) +
      0.5 * CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'sustainability'->>'carbon_footprint' AS numeric) -
      CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'valuation'->>'recovery_value' AS numeric)
    ), 2
  ) as avg_sustainability_adjusted_loss
FROM returns r
JOIN financial_management fm ON r.casenum = fm.casetag;
